name: Beta throwaway made
notes: Done Sep 23, 2026: Flann Anvilhew, level 10 Dwarf shaman, Classic Beta PvE 2. Do not spend Skyrinis, Sorinis, or Malavus. Those names wait for reservation.

name: Reserve Skyrinis Starhollow
notes: Slot 1 of 3. Oct 27 through Nov 3. Skyborne Druid, Feral.

name: Reserve Sorinis Starhollow
notes: Slot 2 of 3. Night Elf Druid, Balance.

name: Reserve Malavus Blackwell
notes: Slot 3 of 3. Human Warlock, Affliction.

name: Rockslicer
notes: Unique two-hand axe. Mines Copper, Tin, Silver, or Iron without Mining. 30 charges, then the effect dies and the weapon stays.
how: Kill Rhahk'Zor, the first boss at the Deadmines entrance. Farm it on Malavus, Sorinis, or Taloninis, the characters without Mining. Clear the same run for First Mate Band and Lookie's Spyglass.

name: Partners in Crime 2-set
notes: Two rings. The 2-piece is an angry proc. The set box stays locked until both rings are checked.
how: First Mate Band drops inside the Deadmines. Band of the Better Half is a level 60 ring whose source is still unpublished, so that piece stays parked.

parts.name: First Mate Band
parts.how: Kill Mr. Smite on the ship in the Deadmines, after the cannon room. Item level 22 strength ring. Bank it. Ephai can wear the same ring.

parts.name: Band of the Better Half
parts.how: Level 60 ring, other half of the set. No drop location has been published. Leave it parked until a source is confirmed. Ephai can wear it too.

name: Embrace of the Viper
notes: Five leather pieces from Wailing Caverns. The hidden 5-piece turns Cat Form into a race-colored serpent that slithers while prowling.
how: Forever bonuses: 2 pieces +10 Intellect, 3 pieces +10 Attack Power, 4 pieces a heal when you drop to 25% health, 5 pieces a chance to stun with Dream Venom. Boss sources match Classic. Gloves are a trash drop, so expect more tries on that piece. Drop rates in Forever are not published.

parts.name: Belt of the Fang
parts.how: Lady Anacondra, the first fanglord in Wailing Caverns.

parts.name: Armor of the Fang
parts.how: Lord Pythas in Wailing Caverns. Chest piece. Requires level 18.

parts.name: Gloves of the Fang
parts.how: Druid of the Fang trash in Wailing Caverns, not a boss. In Classic this was about a 2% drop, so it is usually the long piece.

name: Rotmender's Raiment
notes: Five cloth pieces: Robes, Sash, Leggings, Treads, Gloves. Wear them from level 17, boots at 19. (2) +10 Intellect. (3) 5% less threat. (4) below 15% mana, restore 600 mana over 15 sec, once per 5 min. (5) healing spells can apply Rotmending, 40 health every 3 sec for 15 sec. Robes and gloves bind on equip. Leggings and treads bind on pickup. Drops in Ruins of Lordaeron.

name: Hunter family pet skills
notes: Keep one pet from each family that has a unique skill. The reported payoff is 10% attack power and 100% crit.
how: This is a stable plan, not one drop. Tame the family uniques as you level and keep them. The exact family list is not published as a loot table, so it stays one hunt until those pets are named.

name: Coldflame Saber
notes: Mage sword. +7 Intellect, up to +32 spell power, and +98 Fire melee damage against Frozen targets. Fingers of Frost does not count as Frozen for the proc.
how: Use Scroll of the Saber on Blade of Silverlaine. Both pieces have to be on the mage. This is a weapon, not a new class.

parts.name: Scroll of the Saber
parts.how: Mage Comprehension. Decipher the mysterious scrolls mages find in the world until one resolves into Scroll of the Saber. One beta tester saw it on scroll 119. That is not a pity counter.

parts.name: Blade of Silverlaine
parts.how: Baron Silverlaine in Shadowfang Keep. This is a new sword, not Silverlaine's Family Seal. Reset and repeat the baron until it drops, then use the scroll on it.

name: Library books (10 / 20)
notes: Any class can turn library books in. Ten books pay a neck. Twenty books total pay a ring. The first ten count toward the twenty.
how: Alliance turns books in to Garion Wendell in the Stormwind Mage Quarter. Horde uses Owen Thadd in the Undercity Magic Quarter. Carry the book so the turn-in quest appears. Mages who finish this also learn Research, an hourly Study scroll craft. The set box unlocks after both rewards.

parts.name: Friend of the Library (10 books)
parts.how: Turn in 10 different books. Choose Scholarly Pendant (+6 Stamina, +4 Spirit) or Erudite's Amulet (+4 Agility, +6 Stamina). Neither neck has a level requirement.

parts.name: Greater Friend of the Library (20 books)
parts.how: Turn in 20 different books in total. Choose Philanthropist's Ring (+6 Intellect and up to +10 spell damage and healing) or Field Researcher's Loop (+7 Strength, Agility, and Stamina, rogue only).

name: Malignant Root
notes: Level 32 ring. +7 Stamina, attack power, and a small spell bonus. Unique turn-in, once per character.
how: Kill Nightveiled Rotheap in the Wetlands. /target Nightveiled Rotheap helps. Rotheap Innards is a party drop. Turn the innards in to the Greenwarden. He is hostile to Horde, so this is an Alliance turn-in. You cannot turn in a second one.

name: Barrens rare 2-piece
notes: Blessing of Kalimdor. Two of the three pieces give 5% movement speed in the Barrens and Stonetalon. The set box unlocks at two.
how: The three rares are Humar the Pridelord, Swiftmane, and Takk the Leaper. Wowhead has not published which rare drops which piece, so kill all three on each circuit. Swiftmane patrols fast near Ratchet.

parts.name: Mark of the Pack Leader
parts.how: Neck. Requires level 20. +5 Strength and +5 Intellect. Drops from one of the three Barrens rares. The exact rare is not published.

parts.name: Signet of the Zhevra
parts.how: Finger. Requires level 18. +6 Agility and +2 Spirit. Drops from one of the three Barrens rares. The exact rare is not published.

parts.name: Raptor Hide Cloak
parts.how: Back. Requires level 16. +4 Stamina and +3 Spirit. Drops from one of the three Barrens rares. The exact rare is not published.

name: Hyjal craftable tier
notes: Class crafted sets. Recipes are not published yet, so this stays one hunt until the piece list is real.
how: Patterns are expected from endgame content. Crafting uses Malleable Essence of Nature, which comes from disenchanting Hyjal Summit or Barrow Deeps gear. Shoulders seen in the datamine cost 3 essences. Do not split this into pieces until the slots are confirmed.

name: Reins of the Pack Kodo
notes: Alliance kodo from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.
how: Fill Waylaid Crates and turn them in to Marcy Baker for Merchant's Favor. Huey Sunnydale at Three Corners sells Reins of the Pack Kodo for 6000 Favor.

name: Windcharged Leaf
notes: Reported to cut shapeshift mana cost by 40. Likely a Horde Windshaper relic. Confirm the drop before anyone farms it.
how: Named in Zephras and Shen'dar. No confirmed mob or object yet. Leave it parked.

name: Lookie's Spyglass
notes: Zoom toy, not a combat trinket.
how: Kill Cookie, the murloc cook at the end of the Deadmines, on the same run as Mr. Smite.

name: Prairie Chicken
notes: Egg pet for the first Alliance character.
how: Buy Special Chicken Feed from Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall. Use it on a chicken, then type /chicken until the chicken turns green and offers the egg.

name: Savory Whimsyfin Delight
notes: Cooking 85. One Whimsyfin plus Mild Spices makes two servings. One hour as an ogre or a murloc.
how: Find the recipe in Redridge. This is a cooking recipe, not the Goblin Gumbo Kettle toy.

name: Recipe: Peace Tea
notes: Drops from Frostmane Seers. Bind on pickup. Cooking 25: one Refreshing Spring Water and two Peacebloom. The drink restores 42 mana over 18 sec, then 2 Healing Power for 15 min if you sit for 10 seconds.

name: Musical Gustjumper
notes: Frog pet on Zephras Isle.
how: Go to the waterfall rock on Zephras Isle and serenade the frogs. Taloninis keeps this one.

name: Minimule
notes: Small pack-mule pet.
how: Same Azeroth Commerce Authority vendors as the Pack Kodo. 1500 Merchant's Favor, and it teaches Packmule Treat.

name: Black Market
notes: Gold sink for pets, TCG toys, tier 0, and mounts. Not a gear plan.
how: Madam Swyndle's Black Market at Powderfuse Port in Riverglades. Check it when you are nearby. Do not build a route around it.

name: Goblin Gumbo Kettle
notes: TCG toy, not a cooking recipe. Five-minute poison belch, and it does not feed you.
how: Watch Madam Swyndle on the Black Market at Powderfuse Port in Riverglades. Parked vanity.

name: Zergling
notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.

notes: Forever pet from the Epic Pack.
